# prime-blockui

prime-rs: BlockUI component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/blockui) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-blockui) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/blockui.md)

BlockUI — port of `p-blockui` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A mask `div.p-blockui.p-blockui-mask` with arbitrary content in the center: it blocks the whole document (the mask is in `body`,
page scrolling is blocked) or a chosen element (`target`, the mask is inside it). While `blocked = false`, nothing is in the DOM;
when the block is lifted, the exit animation plays, then the mask is removed. The mask is rendered only in the browser and
is not sent by the server before hydration.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_blockui::BlockUI;

let html = view! { <BlockUI blocked=true><span>"Loading"</span></BlockUI> }.to_html();
// there is no mask on the server
assert!(!html.contains("p-blockui") && !html.contains("Loading"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-blockui = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["blockui"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
